summary: The terminal UI attaches an agent's terminal when you open it (Conversation first in Ctrl+K keeps the old behavior), shows alerts on top of an attached terminal, and reconnects a dropped terminal by itself

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The terminal UI's device preferences gain conversation_first; an older terminal UI ignores it and still reads terminal_first, which is written beside it.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required; a person who wants conversations first chooses Conversation first once per device.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes beyond the per-device preference file; swapping back keeps working.
